functions.role: Store dword in inline slot selected by byte relative key
functions.abi: ECX receiver; stack slots (value32,key); RET 8; EAX boolean 1/0
functions.success: write32(receiver+0xc+4*i8,value32); no calls or ownership transfer
functions.confidence: high direct static contract; meaning of stored dword open

functions.role: Read dword from same inline slot table
functions.abi: ECX receiver; stack slot key; RET 4; EAX dword or zero
functions.success: EAX=read32(receiver+0xc+4*i8); no calls or direct stores

failure.return: EAX=0 after diagnostics; zero may also be a valid slot

functions.role: Return 688-byte record alias selected by full relative key and selector
functions.abi: ECX receiver; four-byte stack slots (selector,key), only signed low selector byte consumed; RET 8; EAX alias or zero
functions.success: EAX=u32(read32(receiver)+688*n); no base-null, extent or multiplication-overflow check; no direct write/call
functions.limitation: No separate i32<=15 test. All arithmetic wraps; ordinary 160-count initialization supports 16 groups of ten only within the corresponding nonwrapping domain. Alias lifetime depends on receiver-held allocation.
functions.confidence: high direct static formula and guards; record contents and full lifetime open

functions.role: Read byte slot selected by full relative key
functions.abi: ECX receiver; stack slot key; RET 4; AL byte contract
functions.success: AL=read8(receiver+0x4c+i32); upper EAX bits zero on success due to prior 0..15 index; no direct write/call

failure.return: AL=0xff after diagnostics; upper EAX unspecified; 0xff can also be valid stored byte

functions.role: Store low input byte in same byte slot table
functions.abi: ECX receiver; four-byte stack slots (value,key), consumes low value byte; RET 8; EAX boolean 1/0
functions.success: write8(receiver+0x4c+i32,low8(value)); no value restriction, calls or pointee ownership
